title: Ordinary generator normalization for a fixed sectionwise scalar model
statement: For every scheme T and fixed model m : SectionModel a T, there exist an ordinary comparison and its scalar-unit generator equation.

source.place: Fixed sectionwise scalar comparison construction, split into ordinary and derived normalization.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized natural transformation, use componentwise invertibility, and assemble its components into a natural isomorphism. The generator equation is preserved by the component equality.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration states this fixed-model half; the parent interface is the only local match.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_ordinary_comparison_exists (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T) :
    ∃ ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ≅
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E,
      ∀ (M : Modules Λ T) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (m : M.X.obj.obj W),
        (((ordinary.hom.app M) ≫ eqToHom (model.obj_eq _)).val.app W)
            (((Mod.extendUnit (ProEtale.coefficientMap a T) M).hom.hom.app W) m) =
          (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf (sectionQuotient a T)
              ((equivalence Λ T).functor.obj M)).presheaf).app W
                ((1 : (ring Λ' T).obj.obj W)
                  ⊗ₜ[(ring Λ T).obj.obj W,
                    ((sectionQuotient a T).hom.app W).hom] m)
